Fix `packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. blocker (line 55): U01 (`createSpecializedApp.test.tsx` -> `should resolve page route refs in app root elements after finalization without render loops`) fails because Round 1 replaced `useSyncExternalStore` with `useState` + `useEffect`. In `createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`, `rerender(finalizedApp.element)` runs on React's `DefaultLane` and mounts `app/routes` -> `<NotFoundErrorPage />` (`React.lazy(async () => ...)` in `DefaultSwappableComponentsApi`) inside `app/root`'s `<Suspense>` boundary (which also wraps `extraElements` / `<RootElement />`), suspending the `DefaultLane` render before it can commit during the synchronous test. With `useState`, `setSnapshot` schedules on `DefaultLane` and gets trapped in that suspended render pass so `'Root link: /my-page'` never commits to the DOM; whereas with `useSyncExternalStore` (Round 0), the store update flushes synchronously on `SyncLane` (committing `'Root link: /my-page'` with `renderCount = 2`), but calling `useApi(routeResolutionApiRef)` directly on every render subscribes `RootElement`'s fiber to `ApiContext`, which `<ApiProvider>` invalidates on `DefaultLane` via an unmemoized `createVersionedValueMap({ 1: holder })`, causing a 3rd render (`renderCount = 3`). — fix: Restore `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot)` per `change_plan.md` U04 (with `subscribe` and `getSnapshot` memoized via `useMemo` on `[routeResolutionApi]`, and `snapshot` in the `routeFunc` `useMemo` dependency array alongside `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`), and read `routeResolutionApi` once via a lazy `useState` initializer (`import { ..., useApi as getApi } from '../apis';` and `const [routeResolutionApi] = useState(() => getApi(routeResolutionApiRef));`) so the `SyncLane` store re-render clears the fiber's `ApiContext` subscription and allows React to bail out on `<RootElement />` during `rerender(finalizedApp.element)`'s `DefaultLane` pass, keeping `renderCount` at 2.
